newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's ASB Bank raises fixed mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: NZ's ASB Bank raises fixed mortgage rates.

text.p: ASB Bank said on Monday it had raised its fixed mortgage interest rates, following rises by some other mortgage lenders last week.
ASB's three year fixed rate rises to 9.95 percent from 9.5 percent, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
The bank's three, four and five year fixed rates are also now 9.95 percent and the one year rate is 9.50 percent, up from 8.9 percent.
The variable lending rate remains unchanged at 9.95 percent.
Last week HongkongBank and the Bank of New Zealand increased their fixed mortgage lending rates, although HonkongBank also dropped its floating mortgage rate to 9.60 percent from 9.75 percent.
